title: 8 精神反馈到肉身9 后怕与教训
content_zh:
回家的路上，熟悉地人影从角落里走了出来。
“林先生，不知昨天的事考虑的怎么样了？”
来人名为贾彦明，溢香茶楼的管事。
与吴管事不同，贾彦明身材标准，脸色严肃，眼神极为凌厉，看起来像极了前世的事业强人。
“抱歉，碧丹茶楼对我有恩。”
“当初我也去过你们茶楼，但还没进去就被小二赶走了，真是可惜呢。”
林哲羽露出可惜的神色道。
当时贾彦明也在场，冷冷地看了他一眼，神情极为冷漠，就像是看见了上门要饭的。
他不耐烦地朝小二挥了挥手，让小二赶林哲羽走。
“您再考虑考虑，待遇我们可以再谈。”
“工钱我们溢香茶楼可以给到您一场三百文钱，然后按照客人数量计算，超过基础数量10人给您提升10文钱，以此类推。”
“碧丹茶楼规模小，您在那的发展前景是比不上我们溢香茶楼的。”
“只要您来我们茶楼，我们……”
“抱歉，暂时不考虑。”
林哲羽打断了贾彦明的话，从他身旁走过。
“毕竟还年轻，读过几年圣贤书，不晓得生意场的残酷。”
“倒是有几分情义，懂的报恩，但，呵……”
贾彦明看着他的背影，神色莫名，轻声呢喃，不知道在想些什么。
……
回到庭院，林哲羽脱下青衫。

这身衣服穿着不舒服，他还是喜欢穿练武用的劲装。
从屋里取出昨天购买的补气益血的药材，倒入药锅中，开始熬炼。
“呼，真是个力气活，要是有个侍女该有多好。”
林哲羽擦拭了下额头的汗水，大口喘气。
早上锻炼了几个小时，身体本就极为疲劳，现在又劈柴、挑水、烧水的，更累了。
林哲羽喘息着瘫坐在地上。
现在的他完全不想动，每动弹一下，对于意志都是個考验。
“不行，怎可轻言放弃！”
林哲羽为自己打气。
练了一个月的桩功后，他的毅力得到了不少增长。
缓缓从地上站起，单单这个动作就耗尽了刚刚积攒下的毅力。
“一鼓作气啊，早知道在梁师傅那就不锻炼得那么狠了。”
林哲羽感受着身体的疼痛道。
他又缓了会，咬咬牙开始锻炼。
“天将降大任于斯人也，必先苦其心志……”
林哲羽念叨着前世名篇来鼓舞自己，强忍着身体的疼痛，与精神中传出的疲惫厌恶，开始了锻炼。
若是连这点苦都承受不了，怎么获得大成就？
content_en:
On the way home, a familiar figure walked out of the corner.
"Mr. Lin, I wonder how you have considered what happened yesterday?"
The visitor's name is Jia Yanming, the manager of Yixiang Teahouse.
Unlike Manager Wu, Jia Yanming has a standard figure, a serious face, and extremely sharp eyes. He looks like a strong man in his previous life.
"I'm sorry, Bidan Tea House is kind to me."
"I also went to your teahouse, but the waiter drove me away before I even entered. What a pity."
Lin Zheyu said with a pity expression.
Jia Yanming was also present at that time, and gave him a cold look, with an extremely indifferent expression, as if he had seen someone coming to beg for food.
He waved his hand to the waiter impatiently and asked him to drive Lin Zheyu away.
"You can think about it again, and we can discuss the treatment again."
"For wages, our Yixiang Tea House can give you three hundred cents per game, and then based on the number of guests, if you exceed the basic number of 10 people, you will receive an increase of 10 cents, and so on."
"Bidan Tea House is small, and your development prospects there are not as good as our Yixiang Tea House."
"As long as you come to our teahouse, we..."
"Sorry, I won't consider it for now."
Lin Zheyu interrupted Jia Yanming and walked past him.
"After all, I am still young. I have read books from sages for several years and I don't know the cruelty of the business world."
"There is a bit of friendship, and I know how to repay the favor, but, huh..."
Jia Yanming looked at his back with an incomprehensible expression and murmured softly, not knowing what he was thinking.
…
Back in the courtyard, Lin Zheyu took off his green shirt.
This outfit is uncomfortable to wear, but he still likes to wear powerful clothes for martial arts training.
Take out the medicinal materials for replenishing qi and blood that you bought yesterday from the house, pour them into the medicine pot, and start to cook them.
"Huh, it's such a strenuous job. It would be nice to have a maid."
Lin Zheyu wiped the sweat from his forehead and gasped for air.
After exercising for several hours in the morning, my body was already extremely tired, and now I was even more tired from chopping firewood, carrying water, and boiling water.
Lin Zheyu gasped and collapsed on the ground.
Now he doesn't want to move at all. Every time he moves, it is a test of his will.
"No, how can we give up so easily!"
Lin Zheyu cheered himself up.
After practicing Zhuang Kung Fu for a month, his perseverance has increased a lot.
Slowly stood up from the ground, this action alone exhausted the willpower he had just accumulated.
"Work hard. If I had known Master Liang, I wouldn't have trained so hard."
Lin Zheyu felt the pain in his body and said.
He calmed down for a while, then gritted his teeth and started exercising.
"Heaven is going to entrust this person with a great responsibility, but his determination must be hardened first..."
Lin Zheyu recited famous poems from his previous life to encourage himself, endured the pain in his body and the exhaustion and disgust in his mind, and began to exercise.
If you can't bear even this little pain, how can you achieve great success?
